rows.note: This is the all-purpose reflexive choice when the speaker is also the subject, as in “I taught myself.”

example.english: I finally learned to take care of myself.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 hok6 sik1 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this when explicitly stressing that the speaker personally, rather than someone else, did or witnessed something.

example.english: I made it myself by following the instructions.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi6 gei2 tai2 syut3 ming4 syu1 zing2 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for emphatic myself when the emphasis is on personally carrying out or witnessing the action.

example.english: I went to the counter myself to pick up the order.
example.jyutping: ngo5 can1 zi6 heoi3 gwai6 wai2 ling1 fo3

rows.note: Use this when saying that someone has returned to their usual physical or mental self.

example.english: After recovering, I finally felt like myself again.
example.traditional: 病好返之後，我終於做返自己喇。
example.jyutping: beng6 hou2 faan1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2 laa3
